title: Falak Sufi Scholarship
institution: New York University, Graduate School of Arts & Science (Hagop Kevorkian Center for Near Eastern Studies)
about: NYU's Falak Sufi Scholarship supports students, preferably women, from majority-Muslim South Asian countries in the Near Eastern Studies master's program. Candidates apply through the regular admission application with an added Statement of Purpose paragraph.
requirements: Students from South Asian countries with a majority Muslim population who might otherwise lack access to graduate education (preferably female)
Admission to the two-year master's program in Near Eastern Studies (joint degree with Journalism and concentrations also eligible)
Commitment to women in academia and to the study of gender in the Near East, Middle East and/or South Asia
No separate form: add one paragraph to the Statement of Purpose explaining how the criteria are met
